name: Count With Me
description: Four hands-on math games: counting and ten frames, making amounts with tokens, place value blocks, and word problems read aloud, from pre-K to 8th grade.

about.concept: Number sense: quantities as groups you can see and move, not only symbols. Ten frames, tokens, place value blocks and spoken word problems each build the same idea from a different side, and the same pieces carry on into decimals, ratios, powers and probability.
about.progression: Each game climbs its own ladder from pre-K to 8th grade. Counting to five grows into ten frames, arrays, area models, hundred grids, ratios and square roots; making five grows into tens and ones, decimal tokens, ratios, percents and negative chips; building ones grows into thousands, decimals, powers of ten and scientific notation; and spoken stories grow from adding to five into fractions, rates, percent change, equations in words and chance.
lifeSkills: Listening to a problem and picking what to do
